subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` as the public SDK contract for plugin-owned JSONL CLI streams and display-only native tool cards?
rationale: The patch implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but creating a new third-party plugin API surface is a durable product/API compatibility decision.

options.title: Sponsor after docs refresh
options.body: Accept the API direction, require a fresh docs-map generation and green SDK/docs checks, then do final wording/API review before merge.

options.title: Keep designing in #95351
options.body: Leave the PR open while maintainers settle event names, result semantics, or a narrower parser contract in the linked issue.

options.title: Reject this SDK surface
options.body: Decline the PR if core should not expose a generic JSONL parser hook for third-party CLI backends now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after docs refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the API direction, require a fresh docs-map generation and green SDK/docs checks, then do final wording/API review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for adjacent plugin SDK and CLI backend API direction is steipete's prior plugin text-transform and CLI docs work.
